title: He Signed In Under My Name

scenes.text: HE SIGNED IN UNDER MY NAME
scenes.narration: The reception camera shows a man signing the visitors' book at one in the morning. Reception locks at seven.
scenes.imagePrompt: An office reception desk at night, a man in a dark coat bent over an open visitors' book, pen in hand, seen from behind, no face visible, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: I went and read the book. The line is there, in fountain pen. Visiting, security. Name, mine.

scenes.narration: The time out column is empty. Every visitor this year has signed out except him.

scenes.narration: According to the book, he is still in the building. According to the book, he is visiting me.
